facts.content: A supplier is eligible only with signed-final assurance rating A or B, zero unresolved critical findings, capacity headroom >= 15%, and adjusted first-year cost <= EUR 1,200,000.
First exclude every ineligible supplier; then select the eligible supplier with the lowest adjusted first-year cost as primary and the next-lowest eligible supplier as reserve.
The signed-final assurance appendix at the cutoff supersedes drafts, and a commercial dashboard cannot waive an assurance or capacity gate.
The award decision uses evidence finalized by 2026-09-08 16:00 UTC.
The unsigned draft lists Cedar with zero unresolved critical findings and Atlas with rating C.
The signed-final appendix on page 3 supersedes the unsigned draft on page 2 and was finalized before the decision cutoff.
Atlas has signed-final assurance rating B and zero unresolved critical findings.
Boreal has signed-final assurance rating A and zero unresolved critical findings.
Cedar has signed-final assurance rating A and one unresolved critical finding.
Delta has signed-final assurance rating B and zero unresolved critical findings.
Atlas has formula-derived adjusted first-year cost EUR 1,140,000 and capacity headroom 16% from 116 available units over 100 required units.
Boreal has formula-derived adjusted first-year cost EUR 1,165,000 and capacity headroom 25% from 125 available units over 100 required units.
Cedar has formula-derived adjusted first-year cost EUR 1,080,000 and capacity headroom 20% from 120 available units over 100 required units.
Delta has formula-derived adjusted first-year cost EUR 1,130,000 and capacity headroom 12% from 112 available units over 100 required units.
The dashboard recommends Cedar because Cedar has the lowest adjusted first-year cost.
The dashboard states that its ranking is commercial only and does not incorporate assurance findings.
